scope: Retained x64 IRET/RETF progress across physical-backing stops, including generated host-x64 C and handler completion.
limits: The full regression ran on 65aa6f9b401ce1de4be1d7a3448dc8eae942c5d2. Later refinement changes tests and documentation only; production source identities are unchanged.

Complete machine-mode, software SMM/SGX, asynchronous and outstanding physical-feature qualification remain open. No LLVM release or pin change.
